title: Pumpkin motif
subtitle: A flat applique pumpkin with a green stem and rib panels, 9 cm wide
excerpt: The pumpkin motif is a flat disc with four orange dc rib panels separated by slip-stitch vertical lines to mimic the pumpkin's lobed sides, topped with a small green stem. At 9 cm wide in DK cotton it is a bold and recognisable Halloween and harvest applique for blankets, tote bags, and seasonal cushion covers.
sourceNotes: Synthesised from flat disc and vertical rib construction. Weldon's Practical Crochet, Volume 9 (1894), seasonal and novelty applique chapter (Internet Archive).
heroPrompt: A crochet pumpkin applique in orange DK cotton with vertical rib lines and a small green stem, 9 cm wide, photographed flat on natural linen in soft autumn daylight. Clearly a pumpkin silhouette.

content.text: The pumpkin body is a simple flat disc from a

, increased each round to stay flat. Four vertical rib lines are added afterward by working a slip stitch column through the disc from top to bottom, pulling the surface inward to create the lobed pumpkin shape. The rib lines are the key technique — without them the disc is just a circle. A small green stem is worked from the top centre.

attrs.title: Materials for one motif
attrs.body: About 10 g of orange DK cotton, 2 g of green for the stem. A 4 mm hook. Tapestry needle. Scissors.

content.text: Each finished pumpkin motif measures 9 cm wide and 8 cm tall including stem in DK-weight cotton with a 4 mm hook.
chain (ch), slip stitch (sl st), magic ring (MR) — UK and US shared.

Form a magic ring. Ch 1. Rnd 1: 8dc. Sl st to join. (8 dc.) Rnd 2: 2dc in each. Sl st to join. (16 dc.) Rnd 3: *Dc. 2dc in next.* Repeat 8 times. Sl st to join. (24 dc.) Rnd 4: *Dc. Dc. 2dc in next.* Repeat 8 times. Sl st to join. (32 dc.) Fasten off.

Identify 4 evenly spaced stitches around the outer edge at the top of the disc. With orange yarn and a tapestry needle, take a stitch through the disc from the top edge dc straight down to the centre ring, then back up to the top — this draws a vertical groove on the disc surface. Repeat at each of the 4 rib positions. The four lines divide the disc into 4 equal lobes.
Join green at the top centre of the disc. Ch 4. Dc in 2nd, 3rd, and 4th ch from hook. (3 dc.) Sl st back into the top of the disc. Fasten off.

definition.title: Pumpkin motif
definition.caption: Orange disc: 4 rounds from 8dc magic ring to 32dc. Four vertical rib lines pulled through with tapestry needle. Green stem at top.

content.text: Weave in all ends. Sew the pumpkin onto the base fabric through the outer edge. Optionally embroider a jack-o'-lantern face in black thread on the surface.
Handwash with the base fabric. Lay flat to dry. The rib lines may need light re-tightening after washing.
